audience: online sellers who track parcels and import shipments with Qapla'

useCases.title: Check the status of one shipment
useCases.text: Get one shipment by tracking number, order reference or Qapla' id. Read its tracking status and the order behind it.

useCases.title: List the shipments of one day and their changes
useCases.text: List the shipments imported for one day. List the shipments whose tracking status changed between two times.

useCases.title: Pick the courier for a tracking number
useCases.text: Guess the courier from the tracking number format. The guess does not check that the number exists. List the couriers for a country.

useCases.title: Check channel connections and remaining credits
useCases.text: Read the sales channel behind the key. Check its connections to the platform and marketplaces. Read the remaining credits.

useCases.title: Import or update shipments by tracking number
useCases.text: Import or update up to 100 shipments. A shipment with the same tracking number and courier is updated, not copied.
